raheemiya.name: Dar-ul-uloom Raheemiya
raheemiya.description: Timings for Jammu and Kashmir (Fiqah Hanafiya) copied from Meeqat-us-Salaat, Darul Uloom Raheemiyyah, Bandipora. Default timings are for Srinagar, use Offsets to calculate for other areas.

etk.name: Educational Trust Kashmir
etk.description: Timings for Jammu and Kashmir (Fiqah Jaffaria) copied from calendar of Educational Trust Kashmir. Timings arranged by Majlis Ulema Imamia Kashmir. You may also use Leva Institute, Qum timings for Fiqah Jaffaria. Default timings are for Srinagar, use Offsets to calculate for other areas.
